Title: Prompt engineering using order-of-addition experiments: An application to generating two-level fractional factorial designs
Authors: Duoduo Danny Ying, Alan R. Vazquez, Hongquan Xu
Notes: Studies order dependency of prompt components using OofA designs and logistic regression. Complementary to presence/absence screening.

Title: A systematic assessment of Large Language Models for constructing two-level fractional factorial designs
Authors: Alan R. Vazquez, Kilian M. Rother, Marco V. Charles-Gonzalez
Notes: Evaluates LLMs as tools to construct orthogonal fractional designs; does not use DoE to optimize prompts.

Title: What Does a Prompt Actually Do? A Systematic Ablation Study of Prompt Components in LLM Code Generation
Venue: IEEE World Congress on Services (IEEE SERVICES / SSE 2026)
Notes: Evaluates 6 prompt components by sequential removal (7 non-orthogonal variants). Demonstrates value of component decomposition.

Title: Efficient Prompt Optimization Through the Lens of Best Arm Identification
Authors: Chengshuai Shi, Kun Yang, Zihan Chen, Jundong Li, Jing Yang, Cong Shen
Notes: TRIPLE framework models prompt selection as fixed-budget multi-armed bandit. Treats prompts as atomic arms without component decomposition.

Title: p1: Better Prompt Optimization with Fewer Prompts
Authors: D. Agrawal et al. (Databricks AI Research)
Notes: Analyzes prompt reward variance and benchmark item subsampling. Motivates item blocking.

Title: A Statistical Approach to LLM Evaluations
Notes: Foundational methodology establishing paired evaluations per item and power analysis for LLM benchmark trials.

Title: Spark-LLM-Eval: A Distributed Framework for Statistically Rigorous Large Language Model Evaluation
Notes: Distributed evaluation with bootstrap confidence intervals and paired statistical tests for complete prompt comparisons.

Title: Expanding the AI Evaluation Toolbox with Statistical Models (NIST AI 800-3)
Authors: Andrew Keller, Kweku Kwegyir-Aggrey, Ryan Steed, Anita Rao, Julia Sharp, Amanda Bergman
Notes: Decomposes benchmark accuracy vs generalized accuracy using GLMMs with item random effects.

Title: A Survey of Automatic Prompt Engineering: An Optimization Perspective
Authors: Wenwu Li, Xiangfeng Wang, Wenhao Li, Bo Jin
Notes: Comprehensive survey of APE methods (RL, evolutionary, gradient, heuristic). Highlights absence of DoE fractional screening.

Title: Factorial Experiments for Developing Multicomponent Interventions
Authors: Linda M. Collins, Joseph J. Dziak, Katherine G. Kugler, Jamie S. Trail
Notes: Establishes fractional factorial screening and ANOVA for multi-component interventions in health/behavioral sciences.

Title: Statistics for Experimenters: Design, Innovation, and Discovery (2nd Ed.)
Authors: George E. P. Box, J. Stuart Hunter, William G. Hunter
Notes: Foundational textbook on 2^(k-p) fractional factorial designs, confounding generators, and resolution levels.

Title: Design and Analysis of Experiments (10th Ed.)
Notes: Standard reference for orthogonal designs, RCBD blocking, ANOVA F-tests, and response surface methodology.

Title: The Design of Optimum Multifactorial Experiments
Authors: R. L. Plackett, J. P. Burman
column13: Classical screening designs for k = N-1 factors with minimal runs (Resolution III).

Title: DSPy: Compiling Declarative Language Model Calls into State-of-the-Art Pipelines
Notes: Programmatic prompt compilation via teleprompter optimizers. Focuses on prompt text generation/synthesis rather than orthogonal factorial effect isolation.

Title: Large Language Models Are Human-Level Prompt Engineers (APE)
Notes: Generates and filters instructions using LLM generation and Monte Carlo search. Excluded from core DoE group.
